_comment: Persistent test users for backend template API tests
_note: Tokens can be auto-issued by the internal test auth endpoint when TEST_AUTH_AUTO_REFRESH is enabled.
_setup: 1. Start the backend server. 2. Configure TEST_AUTH_SHARED_SECRET in Backend/.env and the matching backend settings. 3. Run python tests/run_tests.py --refresh-tokens.

primary.description: Primary test user for most test modules

secondary.description: Secondary test user for multi-user scenarios
